messages.subject: [SAMPLE] New order for 474 and 453
messages.body: Replaces the first order. 474 collects 71 120 and 71 002 at Lengerich; 453 takes 71 455, 71 118 and 70 057 at Bad Bentheim.

messages.subject: [SAMPLE] 71 002 and 71 120 leave with 474
messages.body: Both cars are collected by 474 at Lengerich. 91 044 is dropped with you.

messages.subject: [SAMPLE] 71 118, 70 057 and 91 044 collected
messages.body: Three cars are collected from Münster today.

findings.message: Cars are collected from Lengerich and Münster on a Friday; the workshops close for the weekend.
findings.cite: §7: Workshops are closed at the weekend. Collected Friday evening at the latest; dropped Sunday to Thursday night. Graffiti risk.

findings.message: Door ends of sleeper 71 455 (WL33) in 453 are in no file.
findings.cite: §5: A sleeper car cannot stand directly behind the locomotive, or at the end of the train, with its doors at the wrong end.

findings.message: High-voltage state of the added cars is in no file.
findings.cite: §5: A car without high voltage breaks the power connection to the cars behind it. It can only run empty at the back, and not on a run where the locomotive changes sides.

findings.message: No odometer exists in any provided file.
findings.cite: §7. No odometer exists in any provided file, so this rule always returns UNKNOWN.
